A1.justification: Both PDFs describe Foundry and contain complete, readable main texts and appendices A–E. Their methods, equations, figures, tables and supplementary results can be reliably matched.

before.justification: v1 reports original classification, segmentation, few-shot, distillation, ablation and computational-efficiency results in the main text and appendices.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including benchmark comparisons, architectural ablations and extensive supplementary evaluations.

M1.justification: The DSO/CAU compress-and-reconstruct pipeline, reconstruction loss, gate regularizer and supplied gate code are retained. Appendix B.2 revises gradient-flow documentation; the unchanged Boolean-mask implementation in Listing 1 supports treating this as a documentation correction rather than an established algorithm change.

E1.justification: Both versions retain the same object datasets, three ScanObjectNN variants, few-shot classification, part segmentation, Objaverse checks and large-scene simulations. Changing Appendix B.3's heading from Zero-Shot to Few-Shot matches the experiment already reported in Table 3.

E2.justification: The corresponding comparisons retain the same teacher, specialist students, KMeans-Student, FPS-Student, sampling/group-size controls, ToMe, PiToMe and PatchMerger. No evaluated comparator is added or removed.

E3.justification: Table 9 changes the stated ScanObjectNN condition for linear probing from PB-T50-RS to OBJ-BG while retaining the scores. This revises a reported evaluation condition without establishing that experiments were rerun. Other splits, metrics, budgets and testing procedures are retained.

E4.justification: The architectural variants, direct supertoken-pretraining comparison, loss-function comparison, gate-sensitivity studies and qualitative analyses remain. No tested configuration or analysis is added or removed; revisions concern result attribution and interpretation.

E5.justification: Mean/standard-deviation reporting and repeated-run information are unchanged, including Table 11's 10 baseline runs, three classification runs and two segmentation runs, and Table 14's runtime averaging over 40 runs after 10 warmups.

E6.justification: Section 4.5 corrects the soft-assignment finding from a loss decrease of 0.101 to 0.095 to an increase of 0.0736 to 0.0787, matching the unchanged Table 8. Table 9 reattributes the unchanged 83.24 ± 0.66 and 51.29 scores to OBJ-BG. Benchmark table measurements otherwise remain unchanged.

T1.justification: Table 1 revises the gated encoder's token-count expression from s+(1-r)c to min(s,c(1-r))+cr and changes the worst-case endpoint from r=0 to r=1. Appendix C.3 changes the fused-token count from floor(rN) to floor((1-r)N). These are localized revisions to existing complexity reasoning.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution list and conclusion retain the same claims about foundation-model distillation, learnable SuperTokens, transferable representations and efficient edge deployment. Their scientific scope and novelty claims are unchanged.

C2.justification: Section 4.5 changes the architectural-ablation interpretation: marginal differences previously supported robustness to perturbations, whereas the corrected loss increases now justify the simpler default architecture. The existing single-teacher limitation and supplementary failure explanations are retained.

D1.justification: v2 adds a project-page link and explicitly identifies the straight-through estimator used with DSO's Gumbel-Softmax. Appendix B.2 replaces the gate-differentiability statement with disclosure that target-task gradients do not reach the gate during distillation or fine-tuning. Hyperparameters, hardware descriptions and Listing 1 remain unchanged.

R1.justification: The cited works and substantive research positioning are retained. Several references receive capitalization, venue or publication-metadata updates; the straight-through-estimator reference was already present in v1.

P1.justification: v2 makes localized grammar, punctuation, terminology and bibliography edits, corrects the Few-Shot heading, and revises the ablation paragraph. The overall section organization and narrative remain intact.

P2.justification: Figure 1 loses its frozen/trainable icons and reconstructed-output symbol. Table 1 is resized around its revised formulas, Table 9's dataset header changes, and Table 8's caption is corrected. Text and tables reflow locally; no figure or table is added or removed.

improvement.justification: v2 resolves a clear contradiction between the architectural-ablation prose and Table 8 and clarifies DSO/gate gradient behavior, improving reporting accuracy and reproducibility. Figure 1 loses useful training-status symbols, but this limited presentation loss is outweighed by the corrections. The underlying empirical support remains essentially unchanged.
